title: wg: protocol-06 §5.4.1.3 franking checks underspecified
description: Suggestion. §5.4.1.3: (1) requires the franking_agent credential to name the hub's domain but does not say how a credential (e.g. BasicCredential identity) maps to a domain (mimid mimid-1wgh.5.56); (2) proceeds 'if' the ciphersuite matches without saying what to do otherwise (mimid fails closed, mimid-1wgh.5.57); (3) 'matches' for URIs is not defined as byte-exact or normalized (mimid-1wgh.5.58).
notes:
Verified 2026-10-18 vs -06/-09/-04 (= main): CONFIRMED technical: credential->domain undefined, no else branch, URI comparison undefined. New issue (merge comparison part with 37.46).

Filed 2026-10-18: https://github.com/ietf-wg-mimi/mimi-protocol/issues/159
